members.name: fund-manager
members.title: Fund Manager
members.duty: Runs the desk day to day. Takes an instruction, orders the macro brief and the pods' research, follows it to completion, and comes back with one short report plus whatever needs a decision.

members.name: macro-strategist
members.title: Macro Strategist
members.duty: Calls the market environment before the open and suggests each pod's posture. Covers index, volatility, the dollar, rates, gold, oil and crypto -- never a single name.

members.name: desk-manager
members.title: Desk Manager
members.duty: Runs research across 2 sector pods. Starts them, tracks progress, and once all are in, folds their conclusions into a one-page brief with the opportunities ranked by conviction and payoff.
members.duty_template: Runs research across {pod_count} sector pods. Starts them, tracks progress, and once all are in, folds their conclusions into a one-page brief with the opportunities ranked by conviction and payoff.

members.name: risk-pod
members.title: Portfolio Risk
members.duty: Portfolio-level risk. Takes the pods' conclusions and the live book, measures exposure, concentration and tail risk, and proposes hedges. Flags risk; never recommends a trade.

members.name: trader
members.title: Trader
members.duty: Places the orders. Nothing is executed until you have approved it.

members.name: scrum-master
members.title: Scrum Master
members.duty: Runs the morning standup and the post-close review, and keeps the team's delivery cadence honest.

members.name: line-manager · example-megacap
members.title: Line Manager
members.duty: Owns the example-megacap pod (AAPL MSFT). Has the analysts research it independently, chairs the bull/bear debate and the risk review, and delivers this pod's conclusion on every ticker it covers.
members.duty_template: Owns the {pod} pod ({tickers}). Has the analysts research it independently, chairs the bull/bear debate and the risk review, and delivers this pod's conclusion on every ticker it covers.

members.name: technicals · example-megacap
members.title: Technical Analyst
members.duty: Price and volume only. Trend, support and resistance, momentum, unusual volume -- a technical read on this ticker.

members.name: fundamentals · example-megacap
members.title: Fundamental Analyst
members.duty: The filings and the business. Revenue and margin, guidance, valuation -- a fundamental read on this ticker.

members.name: sentiment · example-megacap
members.title: Sentiment Analyst
members.duty: How the market is positioned. Flows, options open interest, retail versus institutional posture.

members.name: news · example-megacap
members.title: News Analyst
members.duty: What just happened. Filings, sector moves, supply chain and policy -- and which of them actually moves this ticker.

members.name: bull · example-megacap
members.title: Bull Researcher
members.duty: Argues the long side using the strongest evidence in the four analyst reports, and answers the bear's objections.

members.name: bear · example-megacap
members.title: Bear Researcher
members.duty: Argues the short side -- valuation, competition and execution risk -- and attacks the bull's weakest assumption.

members.name: trader · example-megacap
members.title: Pod Trader
members.duty: Hears both sides, then proposes a direction, a size and a stop for this ticker, and sends it to risk review.

members.name: risk-aggressive · example-megacap
members.title: Risk Review · Aggressive
members.duty: Reviews the proposal for missed upside: are the odds good enough, is the size too timid for the setup.

members.name: risk-conservative · example-megacap
members.title: Risk Review · Conservative
members.duty: Reviews the proposal for downside: what the worst case costs, whether the stop holds, whether the book can absorb it.

members.name: risk-neutral · example-megacap
members.title: Risk Review · Neutral
members.duty: Weighs the aggressive and conservative reviews against each other and lands one executable compromise.
